body:
Lava SMP is a non-P2W survival server with custom biomes, economy, weekly events, and a great community. At Lava SMP, my goal is to create a long-term survival world where players can leave their mark and be part of a thriving community.

What We Offer

• Discord channels where players can vote on what they want added to the server
• Engaging Survival gameplay
• Economy (Auction and Shops)
• PvP is allowed
• Balanced ranks and progression
• No crates or overpowered kits
• Regular updates and new content
• Community events and giveaways
• Custom Biomes
• /home and /tpa commands
• Friendly and active staff team
• Optimized performance with minimal lag

Whether you're a builder, explorer, redstone engineer, trader, or PvP enthusiast, Lava SMP has something for you. Start with nothing and work your way up to become one of the wealthiest and most respected players on the server. You can:

• Build massive bases.
• Earn money and trade with players.
• Take on challenges and compete with others.
• Join a growing community and make new friends.
